nodes.summary: The Gamma law is concentrated on `[0, ∞)`.
nodes.title: Gamma law is concentrated on the nonnegative reals

nodes.summary: MGF uniqueness for gamma laws: a real probability law whose MGF equals the gamma `(a, r)` MGF as a function on all of `ℝ` (both vanish where the exponential moment is infinite) is that gamma law.
nodes.title: Moment generating function determines the gamma law

nodes.summary: `Γ(a + k) = a⁽ᵏ⁾ Γ(a)` for `a > 0`.
nodes.title: Gamma function at $a + k$ via the rising factorial

nodes.summary: Scaling a gamma variable by `c > 0` keeps its shape and divides its rate by `c`: `c X ~ Gamma(a, r / c)` when `X ~ Gamma(a, r)`.
nodes.title: Scaling a gamma random variable

nodes.summary: The Erlang tail: for shape `n + 1`, `P(X > c) = e^{-r c} ∑_{k = 0}^{n} (r c) ^ k / (k!)` when `c ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Erlang tail formula

nodes.summary: The upper tail of the gamma law: `P(X > c) = Γ(a, r c) / Γ(a)` for `c ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Upper tail of the gamma law

nodes.summary: Let $a > 0$ and $r > 0$, and let $S$ be the set of real $t$ such that $x \mapsto e^{tx}$ is integrable with respect to the gamma distribution with shape $a$ and rate $r$. Then the half-line $(-\infty, r)$ is contained in $S$.
nodes.title: Half-line of exponential integrability for the gamma distribution

nodes.summary: Let $a > 0$ and $r > 0$. For every real $t < r$, the function $x \mapsto e^{tx}$ is integrable with respect to the gamma distribution with shape $a$ and rate $r$.
nodes.title: Exponential moments of the gamma distribution

nodes.summary: The exponential moment `E[exp (t X)]` of a gamma `(a, r)` law is finite exactly for `t < r`.
nodes.title: Exponential moments of the gamma law are finite exactly below the rate

nodes.summary: `x ↦ x` is integrable for `Gamma(a, b)`.
nodes.title: Gamma law has finite first moment

nodes.summary: For real numbers $a > 0$ and $s > 0$, the function $x \mapsto x^{a-1} e^{-sx}$ is Lebesgue integrable on the open half-line $(0, \infty)$.
nodes.title: Integrability of the scaled gamma integrand

nodes.summary: For `a, b > 0` and `c ≥ 0`, `x ↦ x ^ k e^{-c x}` is integrable for `Gamma(a, b)`.
nodes.title: Integrability of $x^k e^{-cx}$ under the Gamma law

nodes.summary: `x ↦ x²` is integrable for `Gamma(a, b)`.
nodes.title: Gamma law has finite second moment

nodes.summary: The mean of the gamma law with shape `a > 0` and rate `r > 0` is `a / r`.
nodes.title: Mean of the gamma law

nodes.summary: For shape `a > 0`, rate `b > 0` and `c ≥ 0`, `∫ x ^ k e^{-c x} dGamma(a, b) = a⁽ᵏ⁾ bᵃ / (b + c) ^ (a + k)`.
nodes.title: Gamma integrals

nodes.summary: Real moments of the gamma law: for shape `a > 0`, rate `r > 0` and `p > -a`, `E[X ^ p] = Γ(a + p) / (Γ(a) r ^ p)`. (The law is carried by `[0, ∞)`, so the values of `x ^ p` for `x < 0` play no role.)
nodes.title: Real moments of the gamma law

nodes.summary: The second moment of the gamma law with shape `a > 0` and rate `r > 0` is `a (a + 1) / r ^ 2`.
nodes.title: Second moment of the gamma law

nodes.summary: Let $a > 0$, $r > 0$ and $0 < \varepsilon < r$, and let $S$ be the set of real $t$ such that $x \mapsto e^{tx}$ is integrable with respect to the gamma distribution with shape $a$ and rate $r$. Then the interval $(-\varepsilon, \varepsilon)$ is contained in the interior of $S$.
nodes.title: A neighbourhood of zero of exponential integrability for the gamma distribution

nodes.summary: The gamma law has finite second moment.
nodes.title: Gamma law has finite second moment

nodes.summary: Let $a > 0$ and $r > 0$, and let $X$ have the gamma distribution with shape $a$ and rate $r$. For every real $t < r$, the moment generating function of $X$ at $t$ is $\mathbb{E}[e^{tX}] = \left(\frac{r}{r - t}\right)^a$.
nodes.title: Moment generating function of the gamma distribution
$r^k r^{a-1} = r^{a+k-1}$ for nonnegative $r$

nodes.summary: The recurrence `Γ(a + 1, x) = x ^ a e^{-x} + a Γ(a, x)` for `a > 0` and `x ≥ 0` (DLMF 8.8.2), from integration by parts.
nodes.title: Recurrence for the upper incomplete gamma function

nodes.summary: The closed form at natural shapes (DLMF 8.4.8): for `x ≥ 0`, `Γ(n + 1, x) = n! e^{-x} ∑_{k = 0}^{n} x ^ k / (k!)`.
nodes.title: Upper incomplete gamma function at natural shapes
Upper incomplete gamma function with shape one
Upper incomplete gamma function at zero

nodes.summary: The upper incomplete gamma function `Γ(a, x) = ∫_x^∞ t ^ (a - 1) e^{-t} dt` (DLMF 8.2.2). The domain used below is `a > 0` and `x ≥ 0`, where the integral converges. Outside it the Bochner integral may be the junk value `0` (for `a ≤ 0`, `x = 0` the integrand is not integrable).
nodes.title: Upper incomplete gamma function

nodes.summary: The variance of the gamma law with shape `a > 0` and rate `r > 0` is `a / r ^ 2`.
nodes.title: Variance of the gamma law

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
